answers.M6-S1: Some people will do strange things, like walking backward and eating seeds from a witch, just to grow taller.
answers.M6-S2: Because the magic seed won't work if you tell anyone, and Billy only had a little left from the witch.
answers.M6-S3: The narrator thinks Billy is being kind and generous, but the reader can tell Billy is probably tricking him to get his ten cents.
answers.M6-S4: He was worried about being short like Uncle Alec, and Billy was the tallest boy in Carlisle, so the seed seemed to really work.
answers.M6-S5: To make the seed seem magical and special, because it came from a scary witch named Peg Bowen and it was an awful experience.
answers.M6-S6: It shows he is measuring himself on the hall door every day and still hasn't grown, but it's only been three days.
answers.M6-S7: To show how tall Billy got from taking the magic seed, so it seems like the seed really works.
answers.M6-S8: That Billy wasn't very popular and people didn't like him much, maybe because he wasn't always nice or honest.
answers.M6-S9: He loves his uncle and isn't being mean, but he just doesn't want to be short like him.
